description: Land Title Settlement Department - Jayamalapura Ganga Ihala Korale D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320740
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including detailed information about land parcel numbers, owners, extents, encumbrances, and servitude rights. The content falls squarely within the definition of Land Gazettes as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title settlements.
